answer:
- Who is responsible for responding to a severity-one payment incident according to each document: According to the severity-one payment incident runbook (S1), the primary on-call responder responds. The service ownership guide (S2) states the Mercury team owns the payments platform and supplies the primary on-call responder. [S1] [S2]
- Who coordinates the response efforts according to each document: The severity-one payment incident runbook (S1) states the incident commander coordinates the response. The service ownership guide (S2) states the incident commander coordinates cross-team work but does not replace the owning team's technical authority. [S1] [S2]
- How recovery is validated in each document: The severity-one payment incident runbook (S3) states recovery is validated by checking settlement totals after restoring the smallest safe component. The service ownership guide (S2) does not specify recovery validation procedures. [S3] [S2]
